chose: The beat names its role as an optional field, checked per character in the cut list's schema; a beat with no role is the character's everyday self. Its drawing is unchanged except where colour by feeling (C1541) now tints a feeling, which applies with or without a role. The design keeps the name cast-v1: no video has been published with the host yet (its pipeline, HOST2, HOST5, HOST9 and HOST10, has not landed), and HOST3's and HOST4's loops redrew cast-v1 the same way. A change of role on the next beat cuts to the new look while the emotion's loop carries on; the costume joins the figure, so it moves with every loop's pose. Rendering stays a pure function of the beat, the seed and t, pinned by hash.
options: An optional role on the beat, absent meaning the everyday self, under cast-v1
A required role on every beat
A new host design (cast-v2) for beats with roles
gray: Whether a role is a per-beat choice or a per-video one, and whether a change to how cast-v1 draws needs a new design while nothing published uses it, shapes HOST16's signature and every cut list after it.
undo: Remove `role` from BeatOf in host.ts and from BeatSchema in packages/ui/burn-ins/src/lib/host.ts.
